When a circuit is overloaded, it can cause a surge of electricity to flow, which can damage equipment or cause fires.

Circuit breakers trip to prevent this damage by shutting off the power supply to the affected circuit. This helps protect the equipment and prevents further damage. The circuit breaker is usually connected to a switch or relay, which sends a signal to the circuit breaker to stop the power flow.
